Bling Libra runs a data leak site and extortion-as-a-service, launched on Oct. 3, 2025, and the FBI later seized BreachForums domains. Crimson Collective, which the report says works with Bling Libra, claimed a breach of Red Hat. Threat actors claim more than 1 billion Salesforce records were stolen. The report advises retail and hospitality organizations on fraud and extortion risks and recommends zero trust, least privilege and ISAC…

25f76af6c8d919c23e9945a3cfd475d4318decca.summary: BI.ZONE researchers analysed Lizar, a modular toolkit (version 2.0.4) that the FIN7 group distributes disguised as a Windows pentesting tool. The report describes a client, a Linux-hosted server, loader bots and plugins for remote command line access, process injection, credential theft, screenshots and network enumeration. Carbanak is reused as a backdoor. The authors say Lizar is still under development and is mostly used against victims in the United States. FIN7 is also reported to have attacked organisations in Germany and Panama and in several other sectors.
